_note: Boxes are NORMALISED to the tile (0-1). THE PARTY TILE -- this is the 移居 itself, the household on the move: a child minding caged birds, porters with baskets, a robed figure with a fan. It also holds the broadest WATER in z3w, drawn as ripple lines around rocks. Almost no foliage; the motion here is robes and ripples, not leaves.

objects.name: child sitting between two bird cages
objects.note: the most charming passage in the zone and a natural station. Robe and hem only -- the face must NOT deform, and the cages are ruled structures that stay rigid

objects.name: two figures at the left edge
objects.note: clipped by the left edge; one carries a bundle

objects.name: porter with a shoulder basket
objects.note: clipped by the bottom edge; the load is rigid, the robe is not

objects.name: robed gentleman holding a fan, bottom right
objects.note: the largest figure in the tile; wide sleeves and a long hem, so the robe carries real motion

objects.name: figure with a covered load at the bottom centre
the broad stream running through the middle
objects.note: bare silk with fine RIPPLE LINES curling around each rock. The lines ARE the water -- they move as a surface, never as cards. The widest water passage in z3w and the strongest argument that this zone needs water motion, not only foliage

objects.name: narrow fall dropping in at the top right
objects.note: feeds the stream below; 留白 between dark walls

objects.name: lobed-leaf tree reaching in from the right
objects.note: the ONLY real foliage in the tile; red-tipped lobed leaves in loose sprays on an ochre limb -- clean, well separated, an easy hinge subject

objects.name: the scatter of dark rocks standing in the water
objects.note: each is ringed by its own ripple lines -- the rocks stay put and the rings move around them. Animating these is the exact defect Ryan called out

objects.name: the ochre bank the child sits on
objects.note: the ground that supports the figures -- share its depth plane with them (knowledge/share-your-ground.md)
